يبرغش (form IVq)
# يَبْرَغِشُّ (yabraḡiššu) /jab.ra.ɣiʃ.ʃu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْرَغَشَّ (ibraḡašša)
# يُبْرَغَشُّ (yubraḡaššu) /jub.ra.ɣaʃ.ʃu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْرَغَشَّ (ibraḡašša)
# يَبْرَغِشَّ (yabraḡišša) /jab.ra.ɣiʃ.ʃa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْرَغ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
